versions.content: The Dem allows definition of dependent operation cycle s using DemLeadingCycleRef parameter. Whenever the parameter is set, the op- eration cycle is considered as a dependent operation cycle . Whenever the parameter is not set, the operation cycle is considered as "normal" operation cycle .
